messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — planning to roll SDK v2.1.0 to hosted API tomorrow 09:00 PT. Main change: breaking rename of param `timeout_ms` -> `request_timeout`. Need signoff on backward-compat strategy.

Ajay: Is the server still accepting old param? we added compat shim in prod edge

Maria: Yes we've added a shim in handler that maps `timeout_ms` -> `request_timeout` for 30 days. But we want to communicate to clients and bump minor semver. Rollout plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 2 hours. Need smoke checks and rollback playbook.

Sophie: For client comms, we can send deprecation notice via dashboard banner + email to active orgs, do we want k-v to opt in earlier?

Maria: Dashboard + email 24h before. Post-merge note on changelog + migration snippet. Sophie can you draft? :pray:

Sophie: On it. I'll put a short snippet and example in JS/Python and add migration notes.

Chris: Who's running the deploy? I can run canary and monitor metrics. Assigning to me. Will run from 09:00 PT.

Ajay: I'll watch latency and error rate dashboards. Quick smoke: run `curl -X POST` against canary endpoint with both params.

Ajay: snippet:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\
  -d '{"prompt":"test","request_timeout":2000}'
```
And same with `timeout_ms` to verify shim.

Maria: Good. Chris, if error rate >0.5% or p95 latency increases >30% during canary, roll back. Rollback command is:
```
./ops/deploy rollback --service sdk-hosted --to-revision $PREV
```
Make sure rollback has been smoke-tested.

Chris: Got it. I'll prepare a quickplay doc with steps and paste link when ready.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled by @Chris for 2026-11-07T09:00:00-08:00. Canary ID: cr-20261107-001

Maria: @Sophie when draft is ready ping infra-commms for email list. Also we should add a short note in release notes about shim duration 30 days.

Sophie: Ack. I'll target an email template + changelog blurb by EOD today.

Ajay: One more check — any client libs pinned to exact param names? e.g., older python SDK might fail on schema validation. We added compatibility in python and js libs. I can open a PR to bump client lib versions in examples.

Maria: Please do. Also update compat tests. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
